item.title: Lamar Jackson: Viewed as 'unlikely' for Week 5
item.description:
Jackson appears "unlikely" to play Sunday against the Falcons due to a "rarer type of ankle sprain" that could put him at risk of missing multiple games, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
